  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

  • Experience with other SaaS integrations (HubSpot, Gmail, Slack).
  • Experience with data pipelines, enrichment, or analytics systems (We use Databricks)
  • Previous startup or SaaS platform experience.

title: Especialista em Lean
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.

O Lean Specialist em Melhoria Contínua fornecerá liderança prática para implantar, implementar e impulsionar o Programa de Lean Manufacturing nas instalações de R&M.

Essa posição liderará a conversão para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como:

  • Value Stream Management, Safety, 5S, TPM, Standard Work, Kanban/Pull Systems, Root-Cause Problem Solving, Quality at the Source, Lean Daily Management, SMED, POKE-YOKE, Just-in-time, cellular manufacturing, A3/PDCA Problem Solving.

  • Implementar Shop Daily Management (SDM).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em colaboração com gestores, supervisores, equipes e clientes, conduzindo projetos de produtividade, redução de desperdícios, eventos Kaizen e outras iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar a gestão diária Lean e promover a cultura Lean por meio de Gemba Walk, iniciativas de segurança, 5S e gestão visual.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e produtividade, tanto operacionais quanto transacionais, com foco em R&M.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte à liderança das instalações quanto a princípios, metodologias e ferramentas Lean e/ou Six Sigma.

  • Mentorar, influenciar e desenvolver futuros praticantes Lean.
  • Fornecer liderança necessária para promover mudanças e esforços de transformação Lean em todas as instalações de R&M designadas.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia Industrial, Mecânica, de Produção ou Elétrica.
  • Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos de experiência em Lean Manufacturing como líder de melhoria contínua , lean lead, black belt ou função similar.

  • Vivência prática com ferramentas: VSM, 5S, 5Porquês, TPM, Trabalho Padrão, Poka-Yoke, SIPOC, Mapeamento de Processos, Kanban, SMED, Hoshin, PDCA/DMAIC etc.
  • Certificação Lean Practitioner e/ou Six Sigma Black Belt (Desejável)
  • Domínio avançado das ferramentas Lean e capacidade de ensinar metodologias.
  • Perfil de liderança, inspirando e motivando equipes.

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power Automate

We’re looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer who can elevate how teams work with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, process automation, user enablement, and platform governance —perfect for someone who loves building smart systems and helping people use them confidently.

You’ll design and optimize AI agents, troubleshoot complex Power Automate issues, coach non-technical users, and strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence. If you’re the kind of engineer who knows how to turn AI tooling into real organizational impact, this one’s for you.

What You’ll Own

AI Support & Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the go-to expert for Copilot Studio and Power Automate issues
  • Solve connector failures, permission problems, workflow errors, and broken automations
  • Provide fast, accurate root cause analysis

Agent Design & Optimization

  • Review and refine agents for performance, compliance, and scalability
  • Improve prompts, workflows, and architecture patterns
  • Ensure alignment with governance and platform best practices

User Enablement

  • Help employees safely build, extend, and optimize their agents
  • Explain platform capabilities and limits in accessible, non-technical language
  • Promote safe data usage and DLP-aligned behavior

Architecture & Governance

  • Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns
  • Partner with security, data, and compliance teams to ensure DLP and governance alignment
  • Contribute to Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) standards, monitoring, and lifecycle practices

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build user guides, reference patterns, troubleshooting playbooks
  • Identify recurring issues and propose scalable solutions
  • Support observability, health monitoring, and platform oversight

What You Bring

Required

  • Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core)
  • Strong ability to diagnose, design, and optimize agent workflows
  • Understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP frameworks, and governance policies
  • Deep knowledge of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles
  • Excellent communication skills, especially with non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Exposure to RAG , multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts
  • Experience with observability or cost/governance monitoring
  • Familiarity with enterprise data environments (Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake)
  • Prior involvement in a Power Platform COE

title: Product Sales Executive - AI
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a motivated AI Product Sales Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding our AI products and their market landscape, and supporting sales and marketing initiatives. You will play a crucial role in communicating with customers, providing training, and ensuring successful product deployment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Knowledge and Strategy Development

  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of our AI products, including their selling points, market positioning, and competitor strategies.
  • Assist in the formulation of market strategies and the creation of promotional materials for designated regions.

2. Market Research

  • Conduct thorough market research within assigned regions, focusing on clinical workflows, competitor features, market pricing, and business models.

3. Customer Communication and Sales Support

  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored product recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to prepare bid documents for tenders and achieve sales targets.

4. Marketing Activities and Presentations

  • Support various marketing initiatives by creating relevant materials based on customer and medical expert requirements.
  • Conduct professional presentations to effectively communicate product benefits.

5. Training and Development

  • Provide product training to users, including on-site training sessions.
  • Regularly conduct internal and external training for team members.

6. Product Deployment Coordination

  • Coordinate and support the deployment of software products to users, developing and implementing effective deployment plans.
  • Evaluate deployment results and provide timely feedback for continuous improvement.

7. Customer Relationship Management

  • Assist in maintaining strong customer relationships by effectively resolving on-site technical issues.
  • Analyze and organize customer needs to promote product usage.

8. User Feedback and Product Iteration

  • Collect and relay user issues to the development team to assist in product iteration and enhancement.

Qualifications

1. Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Clinical Medicine, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

2. Experience

  • Previous work experience in medical imaging, medical devices, or healthcare information systems is preferred.

3. Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with a strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.
  • Strong logical analysis and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in using Office software for product and data presentations.

4. Travel

  • Willingness and ability to travel as required (over 50% of time)

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de ingestão/transformação como dbt, Talend, Airbyte, Airflow, Fivetran.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Qlik, Power BI, Looker).

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Snowflake SnowPro Core (desejável).
  • Certificação SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer .
  • Experiência com Data Mesh e construção de Data Products .
  • Vivência com pipelines em tempo real (batch + streaming).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de governança/catalogação (Alation, Collibra).

Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Forte orientação ao cliente e foco em valor.
  • Pensamento crítico e visão estratégica.
  • Proatividade, organização e responsabilidade.

Informações adicionais

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Shopify Developer CRO
description:
Shopify CRO Developer

Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $1,800–$2,500/month

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window

Overview

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Shopify expert to rebuild, optimize, and maintain a high-volume DTC storefront. Your work will directly impact conversion (goal: 0.85% → 1.6%+ in 90 days ) and you’ll collaborate with our CRO strategist, growth, and ops teams.

This is a technical execution role — not strategy only.

Core Responsibilities

1. Front-End Shopify Development

  • Rebuild key templates (Home, Collection, PDP, Cart, Checkout) with a mobile-first, conversion-focused approach.
  • Implement CRO/UI enhancements: trust signals, sticky ATC, bundles, urgency, reviews, upsells, cart optimization.
  • Replace heavy apps with custom code when possible to increase performance + reduce cost.

2. Speed & Performance Optimization

  • Bring load speeds under 2.5 seconds across top pages.
  • Remove theme bloat: unused scripts, oversized media, duplicate app calls.
  • Implement:
  • Code splitting
  • Minification + compression
  • Defer/async scripts
  • Lazy loading
  • Image optimization via Shopify CDN
  • Maintain a clean, version-controlled deployment workflow.

3. Conversion & Funnel Optimization

  • Diagnose and fix checkout drop-offs + friction points (Shop Pay, PayPal, Prime, etc.).
  • Improve ATC rate, product discovery, clarity, and mobile usability.
  • Implement A/B testing variants from the CRO team or propose your own.

4. Tracking, Instrumentation & Analytics

  • Configure and maintain GA4 event tracking (ATC, IC, upsells, search behavior, scroll depth, etc.).
  • Set up session recording and heatmaps (Hotjar or Clarity).
  • Interpret funnels with the team and provide actionable recommendations.

5. Reporting & Communication

  • Weekly updates on:
  • Conversion rate trends
  • AOV impacts
  • Funnel drop-off changes
  • Site issues or speed regressions
  • Maintain clear documentation and async communication with product, ops, and design.

✅ Requirements

  • 3+ years building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON, JS, CSS, Shopify APIs).
  • Proven results improving mobile conversion and checkout/speed performance .
  • Hands-on experience with Dawn/OS 2.0 custom theme development .
  • Strong frontend fundamentals: modular Liquid architecture, performance-first coding, clean components.
  • Deep Shopify optimization skills: theme speed improvements, app performance audits, and custom replacements for heavy apps.
  • Experience working with high-volume DTC brands .

✨ Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with CRO tools (Rebuy, Bundler, Zipify, Okendo, Stamped).
  • GA4 modeling, attribution & Shopify Pixel system.
  • Headless / Hydrogen experience.
  • Hotjar / Clarity usage for experience analysis.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo event triggers.
  • Experience partnering with CRO strategists, designers, or A/B testing teams.

description:

Dias Branco para a mesa de milhões de famílias brasileiras. Cada marca ocupa uma posição de destaque em seus mercados, conquistando diversos prêmios em pesquisas junto aos consumidores.

Missão do Cargo:

Atuar no gerenciamento estratégico de contas-chave e distribuidores, garantindo o crescimento sustentável do negócio na região. Realizar visitas e reuniões de alinhamento, apresentar o portfólio de produtos, negociar condições comerciais e desenvolver planos de negócio que impulsionem volume, rentabilidade e execução em mercado. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, estoque e mix), assegurando o cumprimento das metas e a correta implementação das estratégias comerciais. Fortalecer o relacionamento com distribuidores e clientes estratégicos, assegurando eficiência operacional, expansão de oportunidades e aumento de participação da marca.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Administrar contas-chave e distribuidores da região, garantindo performance e expansão dos resultados.
  • Realizar visitas periódicas, reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento in loco.
  • Apresentar portfólio de produtos, novas soluções e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano de negócio anual (JBP) junto aos distribuidores.
  • Negociar condições comerciais, políticas, verbas e ações promocionais.
  • Acompanhar KPIs de vendas: sell-in, sell-out, estoque, cobertura, ruptura e mix.
  • Garantir a execução das estratégias de preço, exposição e presença no ponto de venda.
  • Analisar concorrência, tendências de mercado e oportunidades regionais.
  • Realizar treinamentos para equipes dos distribuidores (força de vendas).
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados para a liderança.
  • Prospecção de novos para garantirmos as metas, solicitada pela Cia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Experiência comprovada em Key Account, Canal Indireto ou Gestão de Distribuidores;
  • Vivência no segmento de bebidas, alimentos, bens de consumo, Farinhas (Food Service);
  • Conhecimento de análise de indicadores, gestão por números e ferramentas de desempenho;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de CRM (diferencial);
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

Será um diferencial se:

  • Pacote Office ou similares;
  • Matemática financeira;
  • Técnicas de negociação.

Informações adicionais

Junte-se a nós e aproveite benefícios incríveis!

Saúde e Bem-Estar - Cuide de você e sua família com:

• Plano de Saúde com possibilidade de incluir dependentes com condições diferenciadas.

• Plano Odontológico acessível e com possibilidade de incluir dependentes com condições diferenciadas.

• Wellhub (antigo Gympass) para acesso a academias, personal trainers e aplicativos de saúde.

• Programa para suporte de doenças crônicas.

• Atendimento psicológico.

Flexibilidade - Adapte sua rotina com:

• Folga de Aniversário: Celebre seu dia em grande estilo!

• Trabalho Híbrido*: Home office até duas vezes por semana.

• Horário Flexível*: Início da jornada entre 7h e 9h.

Família - Apoio para momentos importantes:

• Licença Paternidade Estendida: 20 dias para apoiar na chegada do novo membro da família.

• Modelo híbrido pós licença maternidade*: Iniciativa para facilitar a transição de volta ao trabalho para as colaboradoras que estão retornando da licença maternidade.

• Programa de orientação para grávidas e para o primeiro ano de vida do bebê.

• Seguro de Vida: Proteção para você e seus dependentes.

Educação - Invista no seu crescimento:

• Universidade Corporativa com programas de capacitação contínua, alinhados aos melhores métodos de aprendizagem.

• Licença não remunerada de até 12 meses uma pausa para você se dedicar ao aprendizado e desenvolvimento na sua área de atuação.

Financeiro - Benefícios que impulsionam seu bem-estar financeiro:

• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento pelo alcance das metas estabelecidas.

• Previdência Privada: Possibilidade de reserva financeira com contrapartida da empresa, incentivos fiscais e opções de resgate ou renda futura.

• Cesta Básica: Disponibilizada em cartão eletrônico.

• Alimentação: Refeitório na empresa ou vale refeição (dependendo da unidade e área de atuação).

• Transporte: Vale transporte ou rota da empresa (dependendo da unidade e área de atuação).

• Descontos Exclusivos para você e sua família: Aproveite vantagens em produtos e serviços de empresas parceiras, incluindo faculdades, cursos de idiomas, lojas multimarcas, farmácias, planos para pets, óticas e muito mais!

Venha sonhar, realizar e crescer com a gente!

*Aplicável somente para alguns cargos/posições

Etapas do processo

  1. Etapa: Cadastro
  2. Etapa: Prova de Conhecimentos Gerais ou Específico
  3. Etapa: Entrevista com o RH
  4. Etapa: Entrevista com o Gestor
  5. Etapa: Contratação

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade

Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.

Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz; massas de trigo e milho; farinhas e farelos de trigo; misturas para bolos; margarinas e cremes vegetais; bolos; snacks de milho e trigo; torradas; biscoitos cobertos de chocolate; pasta de amendoim; temperos e chocolates; molhos, granolas; cookies; panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.

Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai. Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

title: Supply Planning Director
description:
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team.   • Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Company

Our client is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of two- and three-wheelers, with a strong global presence across more than 80 countries. In Brazil, the company’s strategic expansion in Latin America and is a rapidly growing multinational motorcycle manufacturer and distributor with annual revenues exceeding BRL 300 million. With operations spanning four key locations- they serve customers across all 27 federative units. As they continue to scale our team, dealer network, and market presence, we are building a high-performance, agile, and people-first organization, and are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support this growth journey.

Role Overview

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Dealer Development, and Support Functions in Brazil. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategy with business objectives, driving people processes, and enabling a strong performance & culture framework in a rapidly growing market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Partnering

  • Serve as the primary HR point-of-contact for business leaders across Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities and design HR interventions to support organizational goals.
  • Drive workforce planning, capability assessments, and talent deployment strategies.

2. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Partner with global and regional TA teams to define hiring needs and support local recruitment.
  • Oversee onboarding and cultural integration for new hires in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labour regulations during hiring and setup.

3. Performance Management

  • Drive annual and mid-year performance review processes.
  • Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, performance conversations, and development plans.
  • Support the implementation of global performance frameworks adapted to local needs.

4. Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for employee issues, grievances, or policy clarification.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazil’s labour laws and internal policies.
  • Partner with legal advisors where required for sensitive ER cases.

5. Talent Development & Culture Building

  • Identify capability gaps and support local training, leadership development, and skill-building initiatives.
  • Lead cultural engagement programs in alignment with Client’s global values.
  • Support DE&I initiatives and cross-cultural employee programs.

6. HR Operations & Policy Management

  • Manage end-to-end HR lifecycle processes (payroll coordination, leaves, benefits, contract changes).
  • Collaborate with HQ in India for alignment on global HR processes.
  • Maintain HR data accuracy, dashboards, and workforce analytics for decision-making.

7. Organizational Development

  • Support org structure changes, role evaluations, job descriptions, and SOP creation for growing functions.
  • Lead change management initiatives during scale-up phases or new business launches.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Masters Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labour laws and HR compliance.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and managing end-to-end HR processes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment with teams across India and LATAM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (mandatory) and English (strong proficiency required).

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving & decision-making
  • Cultural adaptability
  • Communication & influencing skills
  • Confidentiality and integrity
  • High ownership and agility
  • Ability to operate independently in a startup-like environment

title: Venture Capital Analyst
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners is a global financial and strategic advisory firm that connects visionary entrepreneurs with strategic capital. We support innovative companies in scaling through high-impact capital partnerships, leveraging our international investor network, deep market intelligence, and long-term value–driven approach. Our work goes beyond traditional capital matchmaking—combining proprietary sourcing, strategic insight, and a commitment to supporting founders throughout their growth journey.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and analytically minded Venture Capital Analyst with a strong focus on developing investor-facing materials. In this role, you will craft, refine, and manage core content that supports our portfolio companies throughout their fundraising journeys—including pitch decks, one-pagers, and strategic narratives.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the venture landscape and excels at translating complex business models into compelling investment materials. You will collaborate with internal teams, portfolio founders, and design partners to ensure each presentation is both insightful and visually aligned with Evvolve’s high standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation, iteration, and finalization of investment materials (e.g., pitch decks, one-pagers, fundraising briefs).
  • Synthesize business models, market analyses, and competitive landscapes into concise and impactful presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with founders, internal deal teams, and design resources to ensure alignment in messaging, structure, and visuals.
  • Apply insights from investor conversations and market trends to tailor narratives for specific capital partners.
  • Ensure materials meet the strategic objectives of each raise while adhering to Evvolve’s brand and communication standards.
  • Maintain strong quality control and consistency across deliverables, often managing several projects simultaneously.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analyst-level role.
  • Strong proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint required; Figma a strong plus).
  • Clear understanding of early-stage fundraising processes and startup growth dynamics.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex ideas into compelling content.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.

Why Join Us

  • Join a mission-driven team shaping the future of venture capital and innovation.
  • Work with a global network of top-tier investors and high-impact founders.
  • Gain exposure to diverse sectors—from AI to sustainability to frontier technologies.
  • Play a critical role in the capital-raising process for fast-growing ventures.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for global travel and cross-office collaboration.

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We are looking for Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager who can apply technology to promote the success of our retail clients while addressing business requirements through workflow design, configuring software for optimal client results, and conducting training in accordance with best practices. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Atuar na comercialização para o mercado local, apresentando propostas que integrem o ecossistema Iguatemi. Responsável por abrir leads, prospectar negócios e gerar receita com players locais.   • Fidelizar os clientes atuais e prospectar novos, apresentando a Iguatemi, seus shoppings e oportunidades comerciais, a fim de trazer receita e 100% de ocupação para o shopping sob sua gestão;
  • Comercializar propriedades como locações temporárias, mídia, merchandising, eventos, patrocínios e demais que englobam o Planejamento Comercial Anual (PAC) do shopping sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;
  • Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;
  • Visitar a concorrência local/regional, pesquisar oportunidades de negócio nos ambientes digitias (Instagram, LinkedIn, sites de varejo, etc) relevantes a sua unidade a fim de identificar clientes potenciais e se manter atualizado quanto às novidades do mercado;
  • Responsável por atualizar e acompanhar diariamente o placar dos seus índices de performance, resultados, pipeline de vendas, vacância, detectando necessidades de planos de ação para atingimento de metas e maximização do potencial de vendas de propriedades;
  • Realizar reuniões quinzenais junto à gerência geral, Marketing e Operações do seu shopping visando otimizar oportunidades de projetos que possam ser comercializados e alinhar negócios em andamento;
  • Participar de pelo menos uma reunião semanalmente com os demais gestores da unidade de atuação (Matinal) e participar semanalmente da Reunião Comercial Operacional (RECOP);
  • Preparar materiais e apresentações para a diretoria e outras áreas conforme demanda;
  • Gerenciar todo processo de negociação em conjunto com jurídico, shopping e lojista para garantir a efetivação dos contratos nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Garantir o monitoramento de todas as etapas pós negociação, documentação, SISCOM (se houver), assinatura e entrega da propriedade;

  • Realizar todas as atividades em conformidade com as normas da empresa e ao Programa de Excelência Iguatemi (PEXI).

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Solucionar problemas de negócio através de técnicas de Ciências de Dados (modelagem, programação, estatística, otimização, IA Generativa), atuando desde o entendimento do problema e elaboração de frameworks até a execução e acompanhamento das soluções;
  • Criar modelos e ensembles de modelos usando técnicas combinadas de Machine Learning, estatística e otimização para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Interpretar e comunicar resultados (visualizações, storytelling , conclusões) para times técnicos e não técnicos, auxiliando na definição de prioridades e roadmap estratégico e técnico de projetos;
  • Construir e gerenciar análises de múltiplas bases de dados de grande volume usando diversas ferramentas técnicas (SQL, Python, Excel) para criar análises fundadas com qualidade e rigor;
  • Atuar como referência técnica junto a times multidisciplinares (Engenheiros de Dados, Desenvolvedores, UX Designers, Product Owners), orientando boas práticas e garantindo alinhamento com objetivos estratégicos;
  • Liderar todo o ciclo de modelagem, como Análise Exploratória de Dados, pré-processamento, criação dos modelos e deploy, aplicando boas práticas de código e infraestrutura em conjunto com outros profissionais técnicos;
  • Criar ferramentas com o foco no aumento da produtividade do time em atividades críticas de Machine Learning, como pré-processamento, criação dos modelos e deploy;
  • Trabalhar em modelo ágil e de forma colaborativa dentro de squads;
  • Definir junto com times de parceiros de tecnologia requisitos de Arquitetura, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir robustez e automação nas soluções desenvolvidas.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em ferramentas e bibliotecas de ciência de dados (Python, SQL, Excel);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de estatística, Machine Learning e Analytics e desenvolvimento voltados para aplicações de negócio;
  • Curiosidade e disposição em se aprofundar nos desafios;
  • Fortes habilidades de Comunicação (tradução do técnico em linguagem de negócio) serão consideradas diferenciais;
  • Experiencia no mercado ou mestrado e/ou doutorado na área;
  • Desejável experiência com soluções em nuvem e LLM.

Informações adicionais

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

title: Supervisor fiscal
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Supervisor(a) Fiscal para conduzir iniciativas estratégicas de Reforma Tributária, compliance e governança fiscal em uma grande organização.

Sobre o Papel

A pessoa selecionada será responsável por liderar frentes fiscais de alta complexidade, garantindo conformidade regulatória, eficiência tributária e suporte analítico à tomada de decisão financeira.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir a implementação da Reforma Tributária no Brasil, avaliando impactos financeiros e redesenhando processos internos.
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações federais, estaduais e municipais.
  • Atuar com Transfer Pricing e diretrizes internacionais OECD BEPS 2.0 / Pillar Two.
  • Supervisionar obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, PER/DCOMP).
  • Identificar oportunidades de economia tributária e recuperação de créditos.
  • Realizar análises fiscais que impactem fluxo de caixa e performance do negócio.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver equipe fiscal, atuando em parceria com áreas como Jurídico, Contabilidade e Financeiro.
  • Assegurar robustez e transparência em auditorias e fiscalizações.

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em rotinas fiscais, compliance e liderança.
  • Conhecimento profundo da legislação tributária brasileira (ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL).
  • Vivência prévia com Reforma Tributária e impactos operacionais.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência com Transfer Pricing e frameworks OECD BEPS / Pillar Two.
  • Domínio de ERP (Oracle JDE, Tax One) e ferramentas de BI (Power BI).

Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Compensação

Benefícios incluem: plano de saúde e odontológico, benefícios corporativos, programa de bem-estar, refeitório no local, transporte fretado e participação nos resultados.

Interessados(as) podem entrar em contato ou enviar o currículo para participar do processo.
